results.name: Notes validator rejects wrong fields, blank/control titles, malformed Unicode, oversized bodies and nonintegral IDs
Revision comparison rejects stale saves including equal-content ABA histories
Per-window recovery keys are injective; strict codecs preserve content and reject stale/future/malformed records
Amnesic draft path uses actual page-RAM storage operations and the same decoder, never an injected persistent store
Note filter is NFKC/case-normalized, ANDs terms across title/body/tags, and preserves original order/data
Markdown import: fatal UTF-8, byte cap and NUL rejection; exact CRLF body and first heading title
Markdown blocks: headings, fenced code, quotes, list items and task lines, with explicit line budget
Inline view uses text-only tokens; executable/relative/data URLs are not links and unmatched delimiters are linear-bounded
Checklist edits change exactly one marker, preserve CRLF and unrelated text, and refuse stale line numbers
Excerpt extraction is an exact UTF-16 selection, never modifies its source, and refuses empty/out-of-range selections
Search inputs reject malformed source/mode/strategies/scopes, normalize only documented folder/suffix forms
Result order is deterministic, copies rather than mutates, and uses source/reference tie-breaks
Private/RAM literal search preserves whitespace and punctuation; extension filters apply before limit
Missing-path validator does not normalize traversal, trailing separators or private-name aliases
Saved searches retain phrase, field, source, strategy, suffix, order and client filter controls; old v1 defaults migrate
Portable profiles round-trip canonically; malformed, future, oversized and duplicate records are refused atomically
History distinguishes complete inputs, validates neighbours independently, and caps deterministic recency
Index prefix agrees with code-point slicing and cannot emit a split surrogate at the 50,000 boundary
RAM recovery capacity is a real 64-entry bound: refusal cannot evict any live draft and removal releases exactly one slot
RAM byte quota counts actual JSON-escaped UTF-16, not source characters: overflow retains all previously stored large drafts
Wiki-link graph refuses duplicate saved titles in both directions; backlinks reverse only actual unambiguous navigation edges
Backlinks use saved destination identity, not unsaved title impersonation
Generated note titles never split a valid surrogate pair at the import/duplicate cap
